entities.name: Glycine dehydrogenase P
observations: Sequence matches reviewed Pectobacterium carotovorum glycine dehydrogenase (decarboxylating), UniProt C6D8X1, at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.
EC 1.4.4.2; GDC-P domain detected at residues 16–440 and 462–738.
Uses pyridoxal 5'-phosphate and transfers glycine-derived aminomethyl group to the lipoyl H protein while releasing CO2.

entities.name: Glycine P-protein reaction
observations: Rhea RHEA:24304: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[glycine-cleavage complex H protein] + glycine + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-aminomethyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[glycine-cleavage complex H protein] + CO2.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: Reported cofactor for this glycine dehydrogenase P protein in reviewed homolog annotations.
